narrative_element: A child without documentation struggles to enter school; a student without guidance misses opportunities; a graduate without networks struggles to find quality work; a family with unstable income postpones ownership - the barriers compound
evidence_needed: Evidence that documentation status gates school enrolment, MIB 2017 PDF p.36 establishes exclusion from the eKasih WELFARE register; the school-enrolment and employment gating is at PDF p.99
recommended_treatment: RETAIN as the opening frame. It is the strongest narrative device in either document and is structurally accurate. Present as a description of how barriers interact rather than as a claim about prevalence.

narrative_element: Documentation sits with one authority, education with another, training and housing elsewhere; for a low-income household, an elderly applicant, a single mother or a displaced estate family the system itself becomes the obstacle
evidence_needed: None beyond the institutional description itself
recommended_treatment: RETAIN. This is the human articulation of the coordination diagnosis and it justifies the delivery architecture directly.

narrative_element: Money is disbursed. Training is completed. An application is approved. A beneficiary is counted. But the system does not answer whether the family moved forward
recommended_treatment: RETAIN, lightly edited. It is the sharpest passage in either draft and it drives the entire KPI design.

narrative_element: The transition from displaced estate workers to an urbanised community remains unfinished; the IB40 is the defining challenge
evidence_needed: DOSM data on estate-origin populations; the 227600 figure is 2014 vintage
recommended_treatment: RETAIN the structural history, which the MIB documents. REMOVE the presentation of 2014 figures as current. Do not describe the community as defined by its poorest segment - that is the homogenisation the brief prohibits.

narrative_element: Statelessness is the community's oldest open wound and its cheapest to close. A stateless child denied schooling is an irreversible harm
evidence_needed: Evidence on the cost of documentation processing relative to other interventions
recommended_treatment: RETAIN the irreversibility argument, which is sound and is the strongest moral case in either document. REMOVE 'cheapest to close' - no comparative cost evidence exists and the claim is easily rebutted.

narrative_element: A Malaysian-born applicant who had waited since 1947 received citizenship (July 2026)
recommended_treatment: RETAIN only if verified, and only as an illustration of case-by-case resolution. NEVER as evidence of prevalence - the drafting rules prohibit using an anecdote as prevalence evidence.

narrative_element: A child finally receives documentation. A qualified student secures a place. A Tamil school roof is repaired. A graduate joins the civil service. A single mother receives support to grow her business
evidence_needed: None - these are illustrations not claims
recommended_treatment: RETAIN in reduced form as an illustration of what Phase 1 outputs look like to a household. Cap at one short passage; Doc B repeats this device at least six times.

narrative_element: No child chooses the circumstances into which they are born. Whether a child is born into an estate family, an urban B40 household, a fishing village, a new village or a city apartment should never determine the opportunities available throughout life
recommended_treatment: RETAIN. It is also the passage that best satisfies the heterogeneity requirement, since it names distinct sub-populations rather than treating the community as uniform.

narrative_element: It would be a serious political mistake to frame Malaysian Indians only as recipients of welfare. The community includes workers, professionals, educators, traders, entrepreneurs, civil servants and cultural leaders
recommended_treatment: RETAIN and elevate. This is the explicit corrective to the homogenisation risk, and it should appear early in the proposal rather than in the middle.

narrative_element: This plan is written in partnership with the government's own record, which it credits plainly
recommended_treatment: RETAIN the posture, which is politically and analytically correct. CORRECT the underlying list: several credited figures are unverified (RM220m, RM300m package) or misattributed (RM2bn schools programme, SJKP guarantee).

narrative_element: The community has never lacked plans, only execution. Every figure in this proposal is a promise already made and not yet kept
recommended_treatment: RETAIN as the central argument, explicitly labelled an inference. QUALIFY 'a promise already made and not yet kept' - some cited promises (the AS1M allocation) were never made, so the sentence as drafted is false once the fabricated items are removed.

narrative_element: The citizenship backlog sits in the Home Ministry, civil service intake in JPA, matriculation and SJKT in Education, equity and micro-credit across finance agencies. No ministerial-level unit can compel coordination across these silos
recommended_treatment: RETAIN as justification for Prime Ministerial sponsorship and a Cabinet-authorised delegated continuity chain. Remove 'compel', which overstates what any coordinating body may lawfully do; routine delivery must continue below the Prime Minister under GC-01 to GC-08.

narrative_element: One family should experience one Government
recommended_treatment: RETAIN as the organising line of the delivery chapter. It is the most economical statement of the coordination objective in either document.

narrative_element: A self-sustaining, highly competitive Malaysian Indian community - owning proportionate equity, free of extreme poverty, documented, educated and represented at every level
evidence_needed: None - and several components are now unsupported
recommended_treatment: REWRITE. 'Proportionate equity' rests on the rejected AS1M claim; 'free of extreme poverty' is an unmeasurable absolute. Restate the end state in terms the plan can actually evidence: fewer households in absolute poverty, a documented population, a functioning school-to-work pipeline, and measurable growth in savings and public-sector participation.

narrative_element: Government should guarantee progression, not merely provide programmes
recommended_treatment: RETAIN as the proposition. QUALIFY 'guarantee' consistently with CNF-029 so that the government is not committed to outcomes outside its control.

narrative_element: Women frequently make the most important decisions affecting education, household finances and children's wellbeing
recommended_treatment: REWRITE. Replace the unevidenced generalisation with the verified operational fact: AIM PENN financing uptake among Indian women demonstrates demand, which justifies gender-disaggregated design and reporting.

narrative_element: Approximately 12 months remain in the current term; one year earns the mandate, five more finish the job
recommended_treatment: REMOVE ENTIRELY. Disqualifying in a Cabinet submission. The underlying sequencing logic is preserved on administrative grounds: measures requiring only administrative action are sequenced first.

narrative_element: Signature statements, the defining speech, tone guidance and voter persuasion logic
recommended_treatment: REMOVE ENTIRELY, approximately 4,900 words. Noted in the proposal only as a matter to be handled separately under normal government communications protocols.
